notes: Market news arrives - the approved flagship, v1. The home page gains a Market News section: the three freshest headlines from Moneycontrol, ET Markets and Business Standard, aggregated inside the app itself (no server of ours ever in the path), tagged by instrument - and when a headline names something we price, its day change rides beside it in a tinted chip: the news and the move, one glance. See all opens the full list with pull-to-refresh. v2 - a fast move surfacing its freshest matching headline - builds on this.
